tldr: Jupiter through the 12th house expands rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, and endings.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 12th house, it makes more room around rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, exhaustion, endings, and what you are not ready to explain. You may notice what is happening out of sight: fatigue, unfinished feelings, private pressure, or the need to step back before you can understand what comes next.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for giving yourself space to process what cannot be solved by pushing harder.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is disappearing into avoidance when what you really need is rest, honesty, and quiet support.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
